title: PNT Density Asymptotic for Prime Gaps: Filter Algebra Proof

problemStatement.formal: theorem pnt_density_long_interval (c : Real) (hc : c > 0) : Tendsto (fun x => ((primePi ((1 + c) * x) : Real) - (primePi x : Real)) * Real.log x / (c * x)) atTop (nhds 1)
problemStatement.plain: Isolate the filter-limit algebra behind long_interval_density_from_pnt as standalone proof-hole-free lemmas for scaled PNT and long-interval density.
whyMatters: Modular proof structure makes filter algebra architecture explicit

Clarifies why long-interval density follows from PNT but short-interval density requires additional analysis

log(x)/log((1+c)x) tends to 1 because the additive constant log(1+c) is negligible for large log(x)
